# Tree-KG source and redraw boundary

Primary source: Songjie Niu et al., “Tree-KG: An Expandable Knowledge Graph Construction Framework for Knowledge-intensive Domains,” ACL 2025, pp. 18516–18529. https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.907.pdf

Method and visual anchor: PDF page 3 (printed p. 18518), Figure 2; definitions and method in Sections 3.1–3.3 (printed pp. 18518–18521). The locally saved PDF is the source copy. This figure is a new, editable, presentation-scale explanatory redraw. It preserves the two phases and six named operators but simplifies Figure 2's example graph. It is not a pixel replica or an official author figure.

Evidence boundary: textbook segmentation, bottom-up summarization, entity/relation extraction, contextual convolution, core/non-core aggregation, embedding, role-constrained deduplication, edge scoring/prediction, and new-source integration follow Sections 3.2–3.3. The example node names and graph geometry are pedagogical. A dashed loop means iterative expansion, not a precise execution scheduler; the paper says the operators form a predefined flexible action set.

High-fidelity composition study: `TK02_treekg_source_composition` uses the paper's Figure 2 panel geometry, small English labels, before/after graph states, summary nodes, robot operation cues and lower candidate/score field. It remains a newly drawn derivative, not the original figure or a pixel overlay. Its third-party book and robot icon source/license/hash records are in `assets/provenance.json`; the figure is attributed to Niu et al. and does not imply author endorsement.
